title: Penfold
description: Retail & E-commerce | Burwood, Victoria, Australia | Penfold Motor Group is a family-owned auto dealership in Australia that has been serving car buyers since 1964. Originally starting as a used car yard in Blackburn, the company has grown into one of the country's most successful auto dealers, specializing in high-quality vehicles from brands like Audi, Volkswagen, Suzuki, Hyundai, and Mazda. They offer a range of services including vehicle sales, financing options, and car servicing, catering to a diverse clientele. With a commitment to exceptional customer service and a secure online purchasing experience, Penfold aims to make car buying simple and accessible. | Deadline: 2026-09-11T00:00:00.000Z
